leads.published_finding: The state investigative agency said it arrested and charged four former Savannah Police Department personnel after an LPR misuse investigation request.
leads.verified_boundary: Charges and allegations are not a conviction; underlying logs and disposition not established.
what_is_unknown: Obtain filed charging documents, prosecution status and redacted audit findings.
